description: Create a new, empty vault owned by you and add it to this connection. Returns the new vault and the vaults this connection can now use. Once a connection covers more than one vault, every vault tool takes a `vault` argument (a slug or id) and list_vaults lists the vaults. Each account has a vault limit and an hourly creation limit.

slug.description: Optional slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes). Derived from `name` when omitted; must not already be used by one of your vaults.

name: create_vault
title: Create a vault
